title: Coulthart's changing sources on the drone flyovers

tellings.quote: you know, I remember when those the Chinese drones were flying over and he was always like, "My sources say this and my sources say that and he's so confident about sources and then his sources keep changing the story still."

plain: During the 2024 wave of drone sightings over the United States, the journalist Ross Coulthart is said to have kept citing his sources with great confidence while those sources kept changing the story. The hip hop musician Flying Lotus tells this from watching Coulthart's reporting at the time: "my sources say this and my sources say that."
